name: STOCKBENCH
description: STOCKBENCH is a contamination-free benchmark designed to evaluate large language model agents in realistic, multi-month stock trading environments. It measures agents' abilities to make sequential buy, sell, or hold decisions based on daily market signals, assessing profitability and risk management.
reputation: A very recent finance benchmark that is not yet widely established, but is notable for evaluating sequential trading agents in realistic multi-month settings.
notes: Evaluates LLM agents in dynamic real-market trading scenarios; includes metrics like cumulative return, maximum drawdown, and Sortino ratio.
